configuration.joint_support_rule: all 8 states observed in representation-fit and source-validation; otherwise omit joint output from both rich banks and report limitation
configuration.weighted_sensitivity: PWGTP-weighted final metrics on identical selected predictions only
configuration.task_selection: minimum downstream-validation log loss across logistic C1 and one fixed MLP; report both
configuration.attack_selection: minimum attacker-validation log loss across logistic C1, one MLP, one HistGB; report all
configuration.practical_transfer_effect: 0.01 nats lower held-out log loss; descriptive, not significance or admission threshold
configuration.sealed_test_rule: save every release and head/attack selection before reading test outcomes for scoring

metric_definitions.log_loss: Natural-log loss; fixed probability floor from raw scorer, lower better.
metric_definitions.auroc: Binary positive-class AUROC or full fixed-schema macro OvR AUROC.
metric_definitions.weighted: PWGTP changes test scoring only; fitting and selection unweighted.
metric_definitions.selection: Saved validation-family selection, no recomputation from test.
metric_definitions.difference: D_features minus comparator; negative log-loss difference favors D.

0.selection_uses: source-validation mean five-head cross entropy only
